commands.command: cargo test -p quansio-tools --test builtin_packs (every pack tool callable in ToolRegistry::builtin; capability needs are exactly the tools' grant templates)

uv run --project python pytest python/tests/intelligence/test_builtin_packs.py python/tests/intelligence/test_artifact_workflows.py -v (schema/eval checks, capability scan with negatives, provenance digests, pack/skill consistency)
uv run --project python python scripts/dev/pack_records.py (every record digest names its content)
uv run --project python python scripts/ci/supply_chain/check.py (OPS-007 quarantine gate)
python3.12 cap007_mutations.py (old coding manifest, non-effect-class need, surplus need, stale digest, daemon flag each fail the named tests; sources restored with git checkout)
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack 55440> bash scripts/ci/ci.sh (binaries pinned via QUANSIO_TEST_SERVER_BIN/SEED_BIN)
